statistics.bootstrap_unit: canonical chemical identity sampled globally; one shared multiplicity per identity across all folds and predictors
statistics.primary_estimand: unweighted mean of five test-fold MSE differences
statistics.interval: percentile 95%; fixed predictions only, not training uncertainty
statistics.refinement: Supersedes the within-fold wording in the frozen training configuration: some KIBA identities occur in multiple outer folds and must share one bootstrap multiplicity. No model settings or predictions changed.
statistics.linear_stacking: unregularized least squares with intercept fitted on validation predictions only; unconstrained coefficients

ranking_rule: Include every benchmark target ID with at least 20 distinct test chemical identities and at least 2 distinct labels; descriptive macro averages. Target IDs may share a protein sequence.
